codes.name: Grantees experience GNP as slow, hard to work with and fragmented
codes.definition: What grantees reportedly want or complain about, and the grantee risk. All secondhand: no grantee was interviewed.
codes.include: Grantee needs, complaints, satisfaction, target grantee experience
codes.exclude: Internal causes of the delay (go to C1 to C4)
codes.short: Grantees find GNP slow and hard to work with

codes.name: Staff energy is held back by how GNP works
codes.definition: Staff frustration, stifled creativity, appetite for change
codes.include: Lines about how staff feel or what they want
codes.short: Staff energy is held back by how GNP works

codes.name: Decisions travel to the top and wait there
codes.definition: Decision rights are unstated and concentrated at the top, so approvals and decisions travel up to the CEO and Executive Council and wait there
codes.include: Escalation, sign-offs, hierarchy, slow or circular decisions, unclear decision rights, roles and accountability, matrix reporting
codes.short: Decision rights sit too high and are unclear

codes.name: Teams plan and work in silos, so GNP shows up as several foundations
codes.definition: Departments plan, fund and engage separately and compete for budget
codes.include: Silos, cross team cooperation, separate planning, multiple GNPs in one community
codes.short: Teams don't coordinate at the start

codes.name: Support functions join too late and hold up grants
codes.definition: Grant services, contracting and grant management are looped in late and stall the grant
codes.include: Handoffs to grant services, contracting, grant management
codes.short: Compliance joins too late and holds up grants

codes.name: GNP's cross-team ambition depends on skills that are reported as missing
codes.definition: The cross-team working the CEO and COO want needs skills that 4 of 5 interviewees say are missing. Not yet measured: client plans to assess skills in phase 2 and 3 (I5-L44).
codes.include: Skill gaps, generalist vs expert, hiring model, planning and resourcing skills

codes.name: Leaders rose as program experts and are still learning to lead people
codes.definition: Leadership capability and the coaching investment to move away from command and control
codes.include: Leader capability, coaching, leadership alignment, prioritisation by leaders
codes.short: Leaders are still learning to lead people

codes.name: Change is communicated badly, so rumours and resistance fill the gap
codes.definition: Poor change communication plus past scars drive resistance and the flavor-of-the-year view
codes.include: Change communication, readiness, resistance, rumours, past restructures
codes.exclude: Day to day cross team communication (C2)

codes.name: Strengths to preserve: people, mission, values, peers
codes.definition: What interviewees want kept through the change
codes.include: Values, mission, people, peers, passion, community engagement model

codes.name: Cross team working already works when it is tried
codes.definition: GNP evidence that the target way of working has succeeded
codes.include: Strategy papers process and similar successes
codes.short: Cross-team work succeeds when it is tried

codes.name: CEO ambition, strategy and history
codes.definition: Background that frames the case but is not itself a problem
codes.include: Ambition, strategy, mission, geographies, success definitions, org history

codes.name: What staff need to see in implementation
codes.definition: Requests and constraints for how change is rolled out
codes.short: What staff need to see in implementation

codes.name: Fits no theme
codes.definition: Use when a line fits none of the themes above. Do not force a fit.
